template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. provenance.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ in the browser. If you are not already signed in, sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type the password into the password field exactly as the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (the environment fills in the real value as it is typed); never guess or invent a password.
